PR59 · unchanged authored story

Negative contact comparison retained: PR59 did not establish better landscape-related contacts. Straight oblique bands cross the curved elevation pattern; authored phase/width and the active −0.5 clamp partly control appearance. Both lower-mean bands receive cover preservation; their contact has no demonstrated geological necessity. PR58 bends vertical contacts but keeps an arbitrary horizontal seam.

One broad trend across the retained field

The best-fit plane through all 2,401 retained heights slopes down as native x increases and up as native z increases, at roughly equal rates. This is a regional summary, not a slope measured at any marker, and it does not describe every local rise or dip. The authored story uses the ratio of those trends (about −1.01) to orient conceptual bands. Its ±0.5 limit is active: the authored tilt stays at −0.5. That clamp, the seeded phase and the chosen width help shape the contacts; the terrain does not dictate them. Exact trend values and hashes.

Compare Cards 2 and 3: ID −2 and ID −1 are distinct seeded identities, but both receive the same authored cover-preservation event because both bands average below the field mean. Sharing that event does not establish geological necessity for their contact. Different IDs are not evidence of different real rocks.

Limits and next decision

All 2,401 sites abstain from actual geological interpretation. Unknown error is never zero. Contact/tint geometry fills conceptual space, not missing terrain. Source/data checks do not establish browser readability, visual quality, player comprehension or live addon acceptance. No existing browser surface was available for 1200×900 / 1600×1000, keyboard-fragment or scripts-disabled rendering checks; those remain unverified. This document contains no scripts: all maps, markers, cards and caveats are static.

Next decision gate: review this companion’s explanatory value and readability, including the missing browser checks and player comprehension, before separately authorizing any in-addon adaptation. No live validation, adoption or merge authority follows. PR62 stays draft/unmerged; navigation-3 remains consumed/INCOMPLETE, zero remaining. #9/#11 stay open.

All historical failures remain failed: PR51 paired coarse drift, PR52 matching native support, PR57 pressure reduction, height/residual and #5 final-block assertions. PR54 is exhausted; final capture instrumentation is compile-only, historical arrays/indices/ULPs unknown. Geometry/support/uncertainty, numerical reproducer, multi-field joining, fresh validation (new seeds, scales 1/6, signed coordinates, contrasting terrain/multiple contacts and fixed/paired coverage), alternating paired startup/cold/warm/full-route performance, immutable versioned adoption/new-world-only selection, bidirectional continuing-save rejection, exact original-artifact restoration/reopen and complete snapshot/block/persisted-container preservation remain gated. Geology-1, continuing saves, strict production guards, immutable inputs and optional Ulti-World are unchanged.
